agents.name: JSON Formatter
agents.description: Paste JSON — format, minify, validate, query, diff. Syntax highlighting, tree view, TypeScript types. Pure JS, instant.

api.imports: import { formatJson, minifyJson, validateJson, queryJson, diffJson, jsonToTypes } from '@freeagentstore/json-formatter'

functions.name: formatJson
functions.signature: formatJson(input: string, indent?: number): { result: string, error?: string }
functions.example:
const { result } = formatJson('{"a":1}')
// '{\n  "a": 1\n}'

functions.name: minifyJson
functions.signature: minifyJson(input: string): { result: string, error?: string }
functions.example:
const { result } = minifyJson('{  "a":  1  }')
// '{"a":1}'

functions.name: validateJson
functions.signature: validateJson(input: string): { valid: boolean, error?: string, line?: number, col?: number }
functions.example:
validateJson('{"a": 1}') // { valid: true }
validateJson('{bad}')    // { valid: false, error: '...' }

functions.name: queryJson
functions.example:
queryJson({ users: [{ name: 'Alice' }] }, 'users[0].name')
// 'Alice'

functions.name: diffJson
functions.example:
const diff = diffJson('{"a":1}', '{"a":2}')
// [{ type: 'removed', text: '  "a": 1' }, { type: 'added', text: '  "a": 2' }]

functions.name: jsonToTypes

agents.name: Hash Generator
agents.description: SHA-256, MD5, HMAC, Base64, UUID, passwords, JWT decode, TOTP. Uses Web Crypto API. Zero deps.

functions.name: sha256
functions.example:
const hash = await sha256('hello world')
// 'b94d27b9934d3e08a52e52d7da7dabfac484efe37a5380ee9088f7ace2efcde9'

functions.name: md5
functions.example:
const hash = md5('hello world')
// '5eb63bbbe01eeed093cb22bb8f5acdc3'

functions.name: hmacSha256
functions.example:
const sig = await hmacSha256('secret', 'message')
// '8b5f48702995c1598c573db1e21866a9b825d4a794d169d7060a03605796360b'

functions.name: generatePassword
functions.example:
const pw = generatePassword(16, { uppercase: true, lowercase: true, digits: true, symbols: true })
// 'aB3$kL9!mN2@pQ7&'

functions.name: decodeJwt
functions.signature: decodeJwt(token: string): { header: any, payload: any, signature: string } | null
functions.example:
const jwt = decodeJwt('eyJhbG...')
// { header: { alg: 'HS256' }, payload: { sub: '1234' }, signature: '...' }
